rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=0.3, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, n_iter=150, outer_wall_s=1700, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-19: ONE knob -> n_iter 300 -> 150 (HALVE per-scan Adam steps again), at the iter-18 recorded config on the val_n=24 basis (val_n=24/ep6/lr1e-4/warm_start=True/unet_c16/seed42/grad_clip0.3). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): iter-18 n_iter 600->300 LIFTED the val_n=24 seed42 mean 0.443-0.462 (iter-13/14/17) -> 0.49506 (hr 0.03613, PSNR 13.762), the best val_n=24 read so far and approaching the all-time val_n=6 peak iter-5 0.50811. This CONFIRMS the campaign-state insight that fewer per-scan steps reduce per-image U-Net overfit (raising n_iter HURTS: demo 0.4785->0.4293 @n_iter1200). FAILURE MODE = the 0.466 M-param U-Net OVERFITS each single noisy 128-view sparse-phantom scan in the no-early-stop _fit_one_scene loop; structurally FBP-bounded so hr stays ~0. LEVER CHOICE: continue the confirmed n_iter-down trend 300->150 to map its slope -- if SSIM rises again, anchoring nearer the warm-start init keeps helping; if it is flat/down, n_iter has hit a floor and the warm-start init quality is the binding ceiling (finalizes the iter-20 structural-ceiling writeup). This is the least-exhausted productive axis and also shrinks the wall. KEPT FIXED (settled, do NOT touch): warm_start=True (LOAD-BEARING-POSITIVE, iter-8 off -0.0595), lr=1e-4 (iter-3/iter-9 bracket as per-scan optimum), val_n=24 (the stable comparison basis, same as iter-13..18), grad_clip=0.3, unet_c=16, seed=42 (peak basin), pretrain_epochs=6 (iter-18 budget-fit init). HYPOTHESIS: 300->150 keeps each per-scan fit even closer to the good warm-start init, lifting the val_n=24 seed42 mean above iter-18 0.49506 toward/past the iter-5 0.50811 peak. FALSIFIER: if SSIM is flat-or-down vs 0.495 (delta < +0.005 or negative), n_iter has hit its floor and the warm-start init is the binding ceiling -> finalize the structural-ceiling documentation for iter-20. hr expected ~0 either way (structurally FBP-bounded on dense 128-view phantoms). WALL: iter-18 ran 8400 steps in 712 s (~0.085 s/step). New budget = warm 6x200=1200 + per-image 24x150=3600 = 4800 steps ~= 408 s (~6.8 min), and even on a slow node (~0.11 s/step) ~530 s (~8.8 min) -- well under the 15-min target, the outer_wall_s=1700 guard, and the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall. All recon-affecting knobs IDENTICAL to the iter-18 recorded config EXCEPT n_iter 300->150.
